caption: The drawing features a composition of ten rectangular and square textile swatches arranged in a grid pattern on a neutral, off-white background. The largest swatch is positioned in the lower center and displays a light beige fabric with an embroidered design of thin, curved black and brown branches adorned with small green leaves and red buds. Surrounding this central piece are nine smaller fabric samples: the top row includes a blue, red, and white plaid swatch on the left, a vertically striped red and pink swatch in the center with small dark motifs, and a blue swatch with a diamond pattern and small accents. The middle row below has a light fabric with vertical brown dotted lines on the left, a beige swatch with repeating brown and red motifs in the center right, and a vertically striped red, blue, and beige swatch further down on the right. The bottom row includes a light brown swatch with an off-white diamond lattice pattern, and a sandy beige swatch decorated with simple, dark blue sprig motifs in the lower right. All swatches are rendered with clear and distinct patterns and colors, arranged symmetrically around the central, larger piece.
title: Materials from Patchwork Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
